tool_description: Official cryptocurrency market API provides a comprehensive list of coins, profiles, stats, trends, most watch, top gainers/losers, newly created, and more! This API is ideal for web and APP developers.

api_list.name: Most Visited
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://cryptocurrency-markets.p.rapidapi.com/general/most_visited"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "cryptocurrency-markets.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
